title: Why voice agents feel slow
subtitle: A 4-slide primer on latency in conversational voice AI
audience: a product manager evaluating voice AI vendors
footer: Demo deck. Illustrative numbers, not benchmarks.

slides.title: Humans notice gaps longer than about half a second

elements.label: typical gap between turns in human conversation

elements.text: Longer gaps read as hesitation or a dropped call
Slow agents get talked over, which compounds the problem
In healthcare, hesitation erodes trust fast

slides.speakerNotes: Explain that conversation has a natural rhythm with very short gaps, and that anything much longer than half a second feels off. Slow agents get interrupted, which makes things worse.
knowledge: Cross-language studies of turn-taking put the modal gap at roughly 200 ms (illustrative figure for this demo).
Users tolerate longer gaps when the agent signals it is thinking, e.g. a short acknowledgement.

slides.title: Cascaded pipeline vs. speech-to-speech

elements.text: Cascaded: every hop adds latency, but each stage is swappable and inspectable
Speech-to-speech: one model hears and speaks, skipping the STT and TTS hops

slides.speakerNotes: Walk through the four stages of a cascaded pipeline, then contrast with a speech-to-speech model that collapses transcription, reasoning and synthesis into one step.
knowledge: Speech-to-speech models also handle barge-in natively because they own the audio stream.
Cascaded pipelines make it easier to apply text-level guardrails before anything is spoken.

slides.title: Where the milliseconds go

elements.text: End-of-speech detection is a fixed cost in both designs

slides.speakerNotes: Point out that end-of-speech detection costs the same in both designs, while the model and synthesis stages are where speech-to-speech saves most of its time.
knowledge: Semantic VAD can shorten the end-of-speech wait when the user clearly finished a sentence.
Network round trips add 50-150 ms per hop depending on region (illustrative).

slides.title: How to make an agent feel instant

cells: Silence without a network round trip

slides.speakerNotes: Summarise the practical levers and close by stressing that you can only improve what you measure. Invite questions.
